content.title: Documents and Downloads for Development Applications
content.summary: The City of Arvada Development Team provides guides and checklists to assist applicants in compiling complete applications for development projects. Applicants are responsible for understanding the Land Development Code and Engineering Code requirements and demonstrating compliance in their applications.

steps.title: Review Relevant Codes
steps.text: Familiarize yourself with the most recent Land Development Code (LDC) and the City Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications for the Design and Construction of Public Improvements.

steps.title: Use Provided Guides and Checklists
steps.text: Utilize the available process guides, checklists, and forms to prepare your application thoroughly. These include guides for development plan review, neighborhood meetings, annexations, zoning, and more.

steps.title: Contact City Staff for Assistance
steps.text: If you have questions about the guides or application process, contact the City Planner, City Development Engineer, or the Community and Economic Development Department at 720-898-7435 or via email at communitydevelopment@arvada.org.
